context: The vocabulary mismatch problem and its neural fix. LSA in exactly ONE bridge topic (SVD on the term-doc matrix -> the learner's PCA/eigenvalue mastery). Bi-encoders as dual towers (SAME architecture as the recommenders the learner mastered). ANN indexes: IVF as k-means partitioning (their k-means, literally), HNSW as layered greedy graph search (bridge to IR 100 graphs lesson), product quantization, the recall/latency/memory triangle. Then the engineer's lesson: contrastive training, in-batch vs hard negatives, fine-tuning embedders, MTEB and instruction-tuned models, Matryoshka truncation, scalar/binary quantization as recall-per-dollar.
